player_prompt.intro:
Ir zent Shpiler {player_id} in Kvantn Tic Tac Toe.
Ayen simbol iz '{symbol}', un ayer ruch numer iz aybolt {parity} (azoy vi, X1, X3 oder O2, O4).

Tsiel: Geyn a line fun dray klasish marks (solidifirt fun superpozitsyes).

Vi tsu shpiln:
- Af yeder ruch, legt a spuk mark in tsvey andere leere kvadratn mitn format '[a,b]'.
- Di marks zenen entangled, un gelabelt vi 'X1 / X1' oder 'O4 / O4'.
- Ir kent nit legen spuk marks in a kvadrat vos iz shoyn tselakht (solidifirt).

Tsellekht Reygel:
- Az ir ruch shafn a tsikl in dem entanglement graf, es tsellekht automatish.
- Yeder spuk mark in dem tsikl vern a klasisher mark in eyn fun zayne tsvey pozitsyes.
- Aybik dependent spuk marks tsellekht oykh.

Zig:
- Di shpil endet ven a shpiler hot dray klasish marks in a line.
- Az beyde shpilers kriegen a line bay di zelts tsellekht, di eyn mit di nideriker maks ruch numer zig.

Example ruch: '[0,4]' legt a spuk mark in tselder 0 un 4.

invalid_move.already_solidified: איינער פֿון די צעלער איז שוין פֿאַרקלעפּלט.

game_action.placed: Shpiler {player_id} hat gelegt zayn simbol in a superpozitsye tsivishn tselder {pos_a} un {pos_b}.

game_message.dependent_resolved: Dependent superpozitsye iz geleyzt. Tselle ({r}, {c}) iz itst {symbol}.
game_message.last_cell_resolved: Superpozitsye far letstn tselle iz geleyzt. Tselle ({r}, {c}) iz itst {symbol}.
game_message.superposition_resolved: Superpozitsye iz geleyzt. Tselle ({r}, {c}) iz itst {symbol}.

outcome.win: דער שפּילער {player_id} געווינט מיט סאָלידיפיצירטע מאַרקס!
